def VTask.comk {α : Type _} (p : Set α → Prop) (he : p ∅) (hmono : ∀ (t : Set α), p t → ∀ s ⊆ t, p s) (hunion : ∀ (s : Set α), p s → ∀ (t : Set α), p t → p (s ∪ t)) : Filter α :=

    (λ s => p sᶜ)
    he
    (λ s t h1 h2 => hunion sᶜ h1 tᶜ h2)
